name: Workspace Agent
description: Browse every agent this workspace can dispatch, see who is running right now, and open sessions without leaving the workspace — a command-center view over your Agents Platform fleet.

agents_platform_base.description: Agents Platform REST base URL, e.g. http://172.18.0.1:10014. Leave empty to inherit the Agents Platform Runners app's own config at $AW_WORKSPACE_HOME/app-config/agents-platform-runners.json — set this only to point at a different platform or as a break-glass override.

agents_platform_token.description: Bearer token for the Agents Platform REST API. Leave empty to inherit the Agents Platform Runners app's own token. Never sent to the browser — the app backend holds it and proxies every call.
